subject: SEND - New notification from ${notification.sender.paDenomination} - ${notification.iun}
body1: <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>You have<#else>Your company has received a legally-binding communication from ${notification.sender.paDenomination} at <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>your<#else>its digital domicile with IUN Code ${notification.iun}; access SEND to view it.
body2: This communication will be considered legally delivered <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>to you</#if> 7 days* after receipt at <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>your</#if> digital domicile, even if you do not open or read it.
perfection: <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>You have<#else>The company has</#if> 120 days from the moment the communication is delivered to view the documents online. Afterwards, they will no longer be available on SEND and <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>you will have to contact<#else>the company must contact</#if> the institution that sent them.
payment: The deadline for payment, if any, and for any appeals is indicated in the documents.
banner: With a digital domicile, <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>you will not receive paper notices and you will no longer have to<#else>your company will not receive paper notices and will no longer have to</#if> pay registered mail shipping costs.
footnote: *If <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>you<#else>the company</#if> received the communication after 9 PM, the 7 days run from the following day.
footer: You are receiving this communication because you entered <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>your email address<#else>the company email address among the courtesy contact details of SEND. To change your contact details or add new ones, go to your contact details.
